values.value: You kept engines, pumps, hydraulics and heavy machinery running in conditions where failure was not an option. That is diagnostic work: finding the fault, fixing it with what you have, and documenting it. Civilian employers hire for exactly that, and the equipment is usually easier to work on than what you were used to.
